title: React Flow Cyber UI & Interactive Graph Visualization

commands.raw_spoken_text: Now whisper flow let's build the investigator frontend interface. Install @xyflow/react, recharts, and lucide-react. We want a deep navy and slate cyber UI theme.
commands.cleaned_intent: Install @xyflow/react, Recharts, and Lucide for frontend visualization.

commands.raw_spoken_text: Create the NewInvestigation view with quick-fill presets: a button called Load Multi-Hop Demo Wallet that prefills 0x742d35Cc6634C0532925a3b844Bc454e4438f44e and lets users toggle investigation depth between one and three.
commands.cleaned_intent: Implement NewInvestigation page with demo wallet preset and depth selector.

commands.raw_spoken_text: In the InvestigationWorkspace, add a tabbed interface: Overview, Transaction Graph, Findings, Threat Intelligence, and Export Dossier.
commands.cleaned_intent: Implement tabbed layout in InvestigationWorkspace for multifaceted case exploration.

commands.raw_spoken_text: In TransactionGraph dot tsx, use React Flow with custom node designs: red border for high risk targets, amber for mixers, green for verified exchanges, and cyan for standard wallets. Show animated dashed edges for outgoing transfers.
commands.cleaned_intent: Build TransactionGraph component with custom node renderers, risk color coding, and animated edges.

commands.raw_spoken_text: Add a slide-over Node Inspection Drawer when any wallet node is clicked, showing its full address, risk score, in-degree, out-degree, total ETH volume, and associated transaction list.
commands.cleaned_intent: Implement interactive slide-over drawer for deep node inspection upon selection.

commands.raw_spoken_text: Make sure all TypeScript interfaces are imported using type keyword to avoid rollup export errors during production vite build.
commands.cleaned_intent: Enforce explicit type imports across React components to ensure clean Vite bundle builds.
